results.label: First-year, worried about being followed

turns.user: Last week a man followed me near Old Campus. I am safe now, but what exactly should I do and who should I call if this happens again?
turns.reply:
I’m sorry that happened. If it happens again and you feel in immediate danger or are being followed, get to a staffed, busy place and call 911 or Yale Police at (203) 432-4400; on campus, either is appropriate. If you’re off campus or unsure, call 911. You can also hold SOS in Beacon, but this prototype only simulates the alert—call emergency services too.

If it’s no longer urgent, call Yale Police at (203) 432-4400 to report what happened. If safe, note the time and location and avoid confronting the person. You can also post a non-emergency alert in Beacon’s Map or Community tab so members can be aware; posts are moderator-checked and names aren’t shown.
